verse.verse_1: THE HOUR HAS come and split is the moon.
verse.verse_2: But if they see a sign they turn away, and say: "This is the same old lie continuing,"
verse.verse_3: And deny, and follow their own vain desires; but every matter is determined at its time.
verse.verse_4: Messages deterring them from evil had come to them,
verse.verse_5: Containing consummate wisdom; yet warnings were of no avail.
verse.verse_6: So turn away from them. When on the Day the crier calls to the painful business,
verse.verse_7: They will come out of the graves with downcast eyes like an expanding swarm of locusts.
verse.verse_8: They will hasten forward to the caller, gazes fixed. And the unbelievers will say: "This is the day of untold woe."
verse.verse_9: The people of Noah had denied before them, and had called Our votary a liar, and said: "He is possessed," and repulsed him.
verse.verse_10: So he prayed to his Lord: "I am helpless, deliver me."
verse.verse_11: And We opened up the flood gates of the sky with water pouring down in torrents,
verse.verse_12: And We opened up the springs of the earth; and the waters met for a decreed end.
verse.verse_13: But We bore him on a (vessel made) of planks and oakum,
verse.verse_14: Which sailed right under Our eyes: A recompense for him who had been denied.
verse.verse_15: And We left it as a sign. Is there anyone who will be warned?
verse.verse_16: How was then My punishment and My commination!
verse.verse_17: Easy have We made the Qur'an to understand: So is there any one who will be warned?
verse.verse_18: The 'Ad had also disavowed. How was then My punishment and My commination!
verse.verse_19: We let loose against them a violent roaring wind on a day of ill omen, continuous,
verse.verse_20: Which snatched away men as though they were palm trees pulled out by the roots.
verse.verse_21: How was then My punishment and My commination!
verse.verse_22: Easy have We made the Qur'an to understand: So is there any one who will pay heed?
verse.verse_24: And said: "Should we follow only one man among us? In that case we shall he in error and insane.
verse.verse_25: Was he the one of all of us to have been given the exposition? He is surely an impudent liar."
verse.verse_26: "Tomorrow they will know who is the impudent liar!
verse.verse_27: We shall send the she-camel to try them. So watch them, and be constant.
verse.verse_28: Tell them that the water is to be apportioned between them (and her); and every turn of drinking will be fixed (for each)."
verse.verse_29: But they called their commander, who seized and hamstrung her.
verse.verse_30: How was then My punishment of which they had been warned?
verse.verse_31: We sent a single blast against them, and they were reduced to husks of a decayed fence.
verse.verse_32: Easy have We made the Qur'an to understand: So is there any one who will be warned?
verse.verse_33: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.
verse.verse_34: We sent a stone-hurtling storm against them, except the family of Lot whom We saved in the early hours of the morning
verse.verse_35: As a favour from Us. That is how We reward the grateful.
verse.verse_36: He had warned them of Our might, but they passed over the warnings.
verse.verse_37: They lusted after his guests, so We put out their eyes (and said): "Taste My punishment and My commination."
verse.verse_38: And early in the morning the decreed punishment came upon them.
verse.verse_39: So now taste My punishment and My commination!
verse.verse_40: Easy have We made the Qur'an to understand: So is there any one who will be warned?
verse.verse_41: The warnings came to the people of Pharaoh.
verse.verse_42: They rejected each one of Our signs. So We seized them with the grip of one mighty and powerful.
verse.verse_43: Are the unbelievers among you any better than they? Or is there immunity for you in the Scriptures?
verse.verse_44: Or do they say: "We are a well-accoutred army?"
verse.verse_45: The army will be routed and put to flight.
verse.verse_46: Surely the Hour will be the moment of their promise, and that moment will be calamitous and distressing.
verse.verse_47: Surely the sinners are misguided and insane.
verse.verse_48: On that Day they will be dragged into the fire faces foremost, (and told:) "Taste the feel of Hell."
verse.verse_49: We have indeed created all things by measure;
verse.verse_50: And Our command is but one (word) swift as the winking of an eye.
verse.verse_51: We have destroyed the likes of you in the past: So is there any one who will be warned?
verse.verse_52: All things they do are (recorded) in the books;
verse.verse_53: All things small or great have been written down.
verse.verse_54: Surely those who fear God and follow the straight path will be amidst gardens and light,
verse.verse_55: At the still centre in the proximity of the King all-powerful.
